name: Applied Kinetics
long_description: Applied Kinetics is an AI-native, end-to-end manufacturer for data center and energy developers. We supply the transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling systems, and other critical equipment needed to bring new power and compute capacity online. Every unit is built to project specifications, and we manage the process from technical requirements through production and delivery. We shorten lead times and accelerate projects forward, removing the physical bottlenecks holding back the next generation of technological progress.
one_liner: End-to-end manufacturing for data center and energy projects
